run_random_search: run parallelized random search on a CompilerEnv benchmark for a specified runtime with multiple worker threads
create_random_agent_worker: create a RandomAgentWorker thread that runs random episodes in a CompilerEnv environment with configurable patience
summarize_random_search_progress_log_ent: summarize a RandomSearchProgressLogEntry NamedTuple to serialize search progress snapshots to and from CSV format
replay_actions_in_env: replay a list of action names in a CompilerEnv environment and log step-by-step reward progress
replay_actions_from_logs: replay the best actions found by a previous random search run from its log directory
